Laravel's starter kits provide backend and frontend authentication scaffolding for your new Laravel application. Before using Precognition with Vue and Inertia, be sure to review our general documentation on [using Precognition with Vue](#using-vue). When using Vue with Inertia, you will need to install the Inertia compatible Precognition library via NPM: ```shell npm install laravel-precognition-vue-inertia ``` Once installed, Precognition's `useForm` function will return an Inertia [form helper](https://inertiajs.com/forms#form-helper) augmented with the validation features discussed above.

In addition, developers are left maintaining two separate code repositories, often needing to coordinate maintenance, releases, and deployments across both repositories. While these problems are not insurmountable, we don't believe it's a productive or enjoyable way to develop applications. ### Inertia Thankfully, Laravel offers the best of both worlds. [Inertia](https://inertiajs.com) bridges the gap between your Laravel application and your modern Vue or React frontend, allowing you to build full-fledged, modern frontends using Vue or React while leveraging Laravel routes and controllers for routing, data hydration, and authentication — all within a single code repository. With this approach, you can enjoy the full power of both Laravel and Vue / React without crippling the capabilities of either tool.

The provided documentation confirms that you can change Laravel’s language for a single HTTP request using the `App` facade’s `setLocale` method. [S5]

However, it does **not** explain how to:
- Configure an optional `{locale?}` route prefix while keeping `/posts` and `/comments` working without a locale.
- Pass a URL locale into middleware or explain why your `$locale` argument always remains `'en'`.
- Synchronize Laravel’s locale with `laravel-vue-i18n`.

Therefore, I can’t determine a reliable route/middleware fix from the supplied evidence.

Also, a **fallback language** is used when a translation string is missing; it does not establish the default locale for URLs without a language prefix. The documented fallback configuration is in `config/app.php`, typically using `APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE`. [S4]
